definitions.explanation: The largest portion of something; most of a group or quantity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部分|だいぶぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: Most of the work is finished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部分|だいぶぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The majority of the participants were students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部分|だいぶぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{費|つい}やした→費やす：10424_tsuiyasu⟧。
examples.english: I spent most of my time studying.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部分|だいぶぶん}: most of ~, the majority of ~
- {大部分|だいぶぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: for the most part, mostly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大部分|だいぶぶん}: Most part, majority (quantity/amount)
- ⟦{大半|たいはん}→大半：00400_taihan⟧: Greater half, majority (slightly more formal)
- ⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧: Almost all, mostly (adverb)
- ⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧: Many, much

USAGE: {大部分|だいぶぶん} emphasizes that a substantial majority is being referred to, typically more than 50%.
